title: Wisdom, Sirach, Baruch, 1 Esdras and 3 Maccabees
summary: Five more books that some churches read as Scripture join the library: the Wisdom of Solomon, Sirach (Ben Sira, with his grandson's prologue), Baruch with the Letter of Jeremiah, and two books of the Orthodox Bible, 1 Esdras and 3 Maccabees. Each is translated from the Greek, with the Hebrew of Ben Sira's surviving manuscripts beside it, and each says plainly which churches accept it and why others do not.

7 new topic pages, including Ben Sira and His Book, Death, Friendship, Pride and Humility and Scribes.

Where these books number their verses differently from the King James Version (Sirach, Baruch, 1 Esdras), the KJV beside each verse now shows its own verse number, so you can find the same line in your Bible.
A mention of the Letter of Jeremiah anywhere on the site now opens Baruch 6, at the verse cited.
